topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: The news cuts deeper than any thorn, sharper than the rocks I've skidded over. I've been running through the trees, my paws pounding the path we've both walked countless times. But the trail is cold, the scent faded to nothing. I thought the bond was unbreakable, something enduring, like the ancient oaks. Now, it's as if the whole forest has turned its back, leaving me to navigate this thicket alone. Memories are supposed to be shared, to root us, to guide us. But now, they're just another dimming light in a world that seems to grow darker with each step. I won’t stop moving, though. I’ll find my way, even if it means forging a new path where the old one lies buried.
